Wood.description: Requires proof-of-work to produce, as well as a pocketknife or an axe. The cheapest resource--fast to produce, and used as a basic building block to craft various tools and upgrades. Can be converted directly to bits at a rate of 1 bit per wood.

Stone.description: Requires proof-of-work to produce, as well as a pocketknife or a quarry. An easy-to-produce resource used as a building block for crafting various tools and upgrades. Can be converted directly to bits at a rate of 2 bits per stone.

Iron.description: Requires proof-of-work to produce, as well as a pocketknife or a mining drill. Slightly more expensive to produce than wood or stone, and used as an ingredient into higher-level tools and upgrades. Can be converted directly to bits at a rate of 5 bits per iron.

Stick.description: Produced from wood. Used for crafting axes.

BucketOfWood.description: Holds any amount of wood. You can add 1, 5, 10, or 50 wood at a time to the bucket. You can remove wood from the bucket so long as the bucket is not empty.

BucketOfStone.description: Holds any amount of stone. You can add 1, 5, 10, or 50 stone at a time to the bucket. You can remove stone from the bucket so long as the bucket is not empty.

BucketOfIron.description: Holds any amount of iron. You can add 1, 5, 10, or 50 iron at a time to the bucket. You can remove iron from the bucket so long as the bucket is not empty.

Pocketknife.summary: A basic tool for gathering wood, stone, and iron.
Pocketknife.description: A basic tool that allows you to gather wood, stone, and iron. Gathers resources very slowly. Infinite durability.

WoodAxe.summary: A basic axe for chopping wood.
WoodAxe.description: Chops 2 wood per use, and breaks after 100 uses. Can be upgraded to a stone axe.

StoneAxe.summary: A solid axe for chopping wood.
StoneAxe.description: Chops 3 wood per use, and breaks after 100 uses. Made by upgrading a wood axe with 1 stone. Can be upgraded to an iron axe.

IronAxe.summary: A powerful axe for chopping wood.
IronAxe.description: Chops 4 wood per use, and breaks after 100 uses. Made by upgrading a stone axe with 1 iron.

Quarry.description: Requires wood and stone to build or upgrade: 20 wood and 10 stone for a level 1 quarry, with upgrade costs doubling at every level. Mines 2 stone per action at level 1, 3 stone per action at level 2, etc.

MiningDrill.description: Requires wood, stone, and iron to build or upgrade: 10 wood, 50 stone, and 5 iron for a level 1 mining drill, with upgrade costs doubling at every level. Mines 2 iron per action at level 1, 3 iron per action at level 2, etc. Consumes 5 wood per mining action.

Bit.description: Can be produced from wood, stone, or iron at a rate of 1 bit per wood, 2 bits per stone, or 5 bits per iron.

CraftPocketknife.summary: Create a pocketknife. Requires no inputs.
CraftPocketknife.description: Create a pocketknife, an infinite-durability tool used for gathering wood, stone, and iron.

GatherWood.summary: Use a pocketknife to produce 1 wood. (~15 seconds)
GatherWood.description: Produce 1 wood using a pocketknife. Requires performing a small amount of proof-of-work hash mining, approximately ~15 seconds on a modern CPU.

GatherStone.summary: Use a pocketknife to produce 1 stone. (~30 seconds)
GatherStone.description: Produce 1 stone using a pocketknife. Requires performing a small amount of proof-of-work hash mining, approximately ~30 seconds on a modern CPU.

GatherIron.summary: Use a pocketknife to produce 1 iron. (~60 seconds)
GatherIron.description: Produce 1 iron using a pocketknife. Requires performing a small amount of proof-of-work hash mining, approximately ~60 seconds on a modern CPU.

CraftBucketOfWood.summary: Make an empty bucket for wood from 1 iron.
CraftBucketOfWood.description: A bucket holds a stack of wood. You can add and remove wood to it via the appropriate actions.

CraftBucketOfStone.summary: Make an empty bucket for stone from 1 iron.
CraftBucketOfStone.description: A bucket holds a stack of stone. You can add and remove stone to it via the appropriate actions.

CraftBucketOfIron.summary: Make an empty bucket for iron from 1 iron.
CraftBucketOfIron.description: A bucket holds a stack of iron. You can add and remove iron to it via the appropriate actions.

BucketOfWoodAdd1.description: Spends 1 wood and adds them to the bucket's count.

BucketOfWoodAdd5.description: Spends 5 wood and adds them to the bucket's count.

BucketOfWoodAdd10.description: Spends 10 wood and adds them to the bucket's count.

BucketOfWoodAdd50.description: Spends 50 wood and adds them to the bucket's count.

BucketOfWoodTake1.summary: Take 1 wood out of a bucket.
BucketOfWoodTake1.description: Lowers the bucket's count by 1 and gives you 1 wood. The bucket must hold at least that many.

BucketOfStoneAdd1.description: Spends 1 stone and adds them to the bucket's count.

BucketOfStoneAdd5.description: Spends 5 stone and adds them to the bucket's count.

BucketOfStoneAdd10.description: Spends 10 stone and adds them to the bucket's count.

BucketOfStoneAdd50.description: Spends 50 stone and adds them to the bucket's count.

BucketOfStoneTake1.summary: Take 1 stone out of a bucket.
BucketOfStoneTake1.description: Lowers the bucket's count by 1 and gives you 1 stone. The bucket must hold at least that many.

BucketOfIronAdd1.description: Spends 1 iron and adds them to the bucket's count.

BucketOfIronAdd5.description: Spends 5 iron and adds them to the bucket's count.

BucketOfIronAdd10.description: Spends 10 iron and adds them to the bucket's count.

BucketOfIronAdd50.description: Spends 50 iron and adds them to the bucket's count.

BucketOfIronTake1.summary: Take 1 iron out of a bucket.
BucketOfIronTake1.description: Lowers the bucket's count by 1 and gives you 1 iron. The bucket must hold at least that many.

CraftWoodAxe.summary: Make a wooden axe from 2 sticks and 1 wood.
CraftWoodAxe.description: Consumes 2 sticks and 1 wood to create a wooden axe, which chops wood twice as fast as a pocketknife. Axes start with 100 durability, meaning that they are unusable after 100 uses.

CraftStoneAxe.summary: Upgrade a wooden axe to a stone axe using 1 stone.
CraftStoneAxe.description: Consumes a wooden axe and 1 stone to create a stone axe, which chops wood three times as fast as a pocketknife. Axes start with 100 durability, meaning that they are unusable after 100 uses.

CraftIronAxe.summary: Upgrade a stone axe to an iron axe using 1 iron.
CraftIronAxe.description: Consumes a stone axe and 1 iron to create an iron axe, which chops wood four times as fast as a pocketknife. Axes start with 100 durability, meaning that they are unusable after 100 uses.

UseWoodAxe.summary: Use a wooden axe to produce 2 wood. (~15 seconds)
UseWoodAxe.description: Produce 2 wood using a wooden axe. Requires performing a small amount of proof-of-work hash mining, approximately ~15 seconds on a modern CPU. Consumes 1 durability of the axe.

UseStoneAxe.summary: Use a stone axe to produce 3 wood. (~15 seconds)
UseStoneAxe.description: Produce 3 wood using a stone axe. Requires performing a small amount of proof-of-work hash mining, approximately ~15 seconds on a modern CPU. Consumes 1 durability of the axe.

UseIronAxe.summary: Use an iron axe to produce 4 wood. (~15 seconds)
UseIronAxe.description: Produce 4 wood using an iron axe. Requires performing a small amount of proof-of-work hash mining, approximately ~15 seconds on a modern CPU. Consumes 1 durability of the axe.

UseQuarry1.summary: Use a level 1 quarry to produce 2 stone.
UseQuarry1.description: Produce 2 stone using a quarry. Requires performing a small amount of proof-of-work hash mining, approximately ~30 seconds on a modern CPU.

UseMiningDrill1.summary: Use a level 1 mining drill to produce 2 iron.
UseMiningDrill1.description: Produce 2 iron using a mining drill. Consumes 5 wood, and requires performing a small amount of proof-of-work hash mining, approximately ~60 seconds on a modern CPU.

UseQuarry2.summary: Use a level 2 quarry to produce 3 stone.
UseQuarry2.description: Produce 3 stone using a quarry. Requires performing a small amount of proof-of-work hash mining, approximately ~30 seconds on a modern CPU.

UseMiningDrill2.summary: Use a level 2 mining drill to produce 3 iron.
UseMiningDrill2.description: Produce 3 iron using a mining drill. Consumes 5 wood, and requires performing a small amount of proof-of-work hash mining, approximately ~60 seconds on a modern CPU.

UseQuarry3.summary: Use a level 3 quarry to produce 4 stone.
UseQuarry3.description: Produce 4 stone using a quarry. Requires performing a small amount of proof-of-work hash mining, approximately ~30 seconds on a modern CPU.

UseMiningDrill3.summary: Use a level 3 mining drill to produce 4 iron.
UseMiningDrill3.description: Produce 4 iron using a mining drill. Consumes 5 wood, and requires performing a small amount of proof-of-work hash mining, approximately ~60 seconds on a modern CPU.

UseQuarry4.summary: Use a level 4 quarry to produce 5 stone.
UseQuarry4.description: Produce 5 stone using a quarry. Requires performing a small amount of proof-of-work hash mining, approximately ~30 seconds on a modern CPU.

UseMiningDrill4.summary: Use a level 4 mining drill to produce 5 iron.
UseMiningDrill4.description: Produce 5 iron using a mining drill. Consumes 5 wood, and requires performing a small amount of proof-of-work hash mining, approximately ~60 seconds on a modern CPU.

UseQuarry5.summary: Use a level 5 quarry to produce 6 stone.
UseQuarry5.description: Produce 6 stone using a quarry. Requires performing a small amount of proof-of-work hash mining, approximately ~30 seconds on a modern CPU.

UseMiningDrill5.summary: Use a level 5 mining drill to produce 6 iron.
UseMiningDrill5.description: Produce 6 iron using a mining drill. Consumes 5 wood, and requires performing a small amount of proof-of-work hash mining, approximately ~60 seconds on a modern CPU.

UseQuarry6.summary: Use a level 6 quarry to produce 7 stone.
UseQuarry6.description: Produce 7 stone using a quarry. Requires performing a small amount of proof-of-work hash mining, approximately ~30 seconds on a modern CPU.

UseMiningDrill6.summary: Use a level 6 mining drill to produce 7 iron.
UseMiningDrill6.description: Produce 7 iron using a mining drill. Consumes 5 wood, and requires performing a small amount of proof-of-work hash mining, approximately ~60 seconds on a modern CPU.

BuildQuarry.summary: Make a level 1 quarry using 20 wood and 10 stone.
BuildQuarry.description: A level 1 quarry mines stone twice as fast as a pocketknife. Quarries have infinite durability, and can be upgraded to produce stone even faster.

BuildMiningDrill.summary: Make a level 1 mining drill using 10 wood, 50 stone, and 5 iron.
BuildMiningDrill.description: A level 1 mining drill mines iron twice as fast as a pocketknife. Mining drills have infinite durability, and can be upgraded to produce iron even faster.

LevelUpQuarry1.summary: Upgrades a level 1 quarry to level 2.
LevelUpQuarry1.description: Only works on a quarry at exactly level 1. Spends a bucket holding exactly 40 wood and a bucket holding exactly 20 stone. A level 2 quarry mines stone 3 times as fast as a pocketknife.

LevelUpMiningDrill1.summary: Upgrades a level 1 mining drill to level 2.
LevelUpMiningDrill1.description: Only works on a mining drill at exactly level 1. Spends buckets holding exactly 20 wood, 100 stone and 10 iron. A level 2 mining drill mines iron 3 times as fast as a pocketknife.

LevelUpQuarry2.summary: Upgrades a level 2 quarry to level 3.
LevelUpQuarry2.description: Only works on a quarry at exactly level 2. Spends a bucket holding exactly 80 wood and a bucket holding exactly 40 stone. A level 3 quarry mines stone 4 times as fast as a pocketknife.

LevelUpMiningDrill2.summary: Upgrades a level 2 mining drill to level 3.
LevelUpMiningDrill2.description: Only works on a mining drill at exactly level 2. Spends buckets holding exactly 40 wood, 200 stone and 20 iron. A level 3 mining drill mines iron 4 times as fast as a pocketknife.

LevelUpQuarry3.summary: Upgrades a level 3 quarry to level 4.
LevelUpQuarry3.description: Only works on a quarry at exactly level 3. Spends a bucket holding exactly 160 wood and a bucket holding exactly 80 stone. A level 4 quarry mines stone 5 times as fast as a pocketknife.

LevelUpMiningDrill3.summary: Upgrades a level 3 mining drill to level 4.
LevelUpMiningDrill3.description: Only works on a mining drill at exactly level 3. Spends buckets holding exactly 80 wood, 400 stone and 40 iron. A level 4 mining drill mines iron 5 times as fast as a pocketknife.

LevelUpQuarry4.summary: Upgrades a level 4 quarry to level 5.
LevelUpQuarry4.description: Only works on a quarry at exactly level 4. Spends a bucket holding exactly 320 wood and a bucket holding exactly 160 stone. A level 5 quarry mines stone 6 times as fast as a pocketknife.

LevelUpMiningDrill4.summary: Upgrades a level 4 mining drill to level 5.
LevelUpMiningDrill4.description: Only works on a mining drill at exactly level 4. Spends buckets holding exactly 160 wood, 800 stone and 80 iron. A level 5 mining drill mines iron 6 times as fast as a pocketknife.

LevelUpQuarry5.summary: Upgrades a level 5 quarry to level 6.
LevelUpQuarry5.description: Only works on a quarry at exactly level 5. Spends a bucket holding exactly 640 wood and a bucket holding exactly 320 stone. A level 6 quarry mines stone 7 times as fast as a pocketknife.

LevelUpMiningDrill5.summary: Upgrades a level 5 mining drill to level 6.
LevelUpMiningDrill5.description: Only works on a mining drill at exactly level 5. Spends buckets holding exactly 320 wood, 1600 stone and 160 iron. A level 6 mining drill mines iron 7 times as fast as a pocketknife.
